messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] HIGH: runtime-prod-eu: queue_depth p95=812 (>700) | latency p95=1.9s (>1.2s) | 5xx spike. Grafana: https://grafana/internal/d/rt?panel=queue&orgId=1. Paging @alice_oncall and @ben_sre.

alice_oncall: ack i'm on it — paging ben & carla. switching to incident rotation. i'm taking lead.

ben_sre: checking metrics now. in-flight > max_inflight for worker-pool eu-01; backlog growing. see 429 from rate-limiter on /v1/embeddings/create. looks like partner throughput spike.

carla_runtime: on runtime. KV cache misses up, batching latencies spiking. Suggest immediate mitigations: reduce max_inflight (120 -> 60), enable low-priority shedding, and bump request timeout to 45s temporarily. I can apply via admin API.

dave_support: we have 3 active reports: acme-inc-prod (10% errors), betaapp-eu (timeouts), internal-staging. cc @ellen_cx.

ellen_cx: i'll ping account teams and send a customer status note for acme. they asked to be warned.

carla_runtime: commands i recommend running (admin-only):
```
# reduce max inflight
curl -s -X POST https://admin.internal/runtime/eu-01/config \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"max_inflight":60}'

# enable shedding for low-priority requests
curl -s -X POST https://admin.internal/runtime/eu-01/policies \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"shedding": {"strategy": "priority", "threshold": 50}}'
```

alice_oncall: applying max_inflight change now. will wait 30s and then enable shedding if queue not improving.

deploy-bot: action queued: config_update request accepted (id=cfg-4400123456-1). executor=carla_runtime.

carla_runtime: applied both changes. logs:
```
2026-03-17T15:12:34Z cfg-4400123456-1 apply ok
2026-03-17T15:12:40Z shedding enabled (priority threshold=50)
2026-03-17T15:12:45Z request_timeout updated to 45s
```

ben_sre: quick metric update: queue_depth p95 down 812 -> 320 within 45s. p95 latency down 1.9s -> 1.1s. error rate decreasing but still seeing 429s for very large embed jobs.

frank_pm: can we also flip streaming off for embeddings temporarily? long lived streams tie up slots.

carla_runtime: yep can flip streaming=false for embed route in eu-01. running flag toggle now.

deploy-bot: feature_flag_update ok (id=ff-4400123456-2) — streaming=false for /v1/embeddings in eu-01.

ben_sre: confirmed 429s reduced ~70% for large jobs. overall throughput stable. recommend keep mitigations for 30m and then roll back gradually while watching errors.

alice_oncall: plan accepted. action items: ellen notify top customers, dave update support tickets with mitigation, carla leave config change notes in runbook, ben continue monitoring and escalate if >5% errors reappear. i'll follow up in 30m in this thread. :thumbsup:
